module: Utilities for reading JSONL files (one JSON object per line), used to load the rally recce recordings (driveline, cuts, transcriptions). Empty lines and those starting with `//` are ignored by parseJsonlFile.
usage: local objs, err = gameplay_rally_util_jsonlUtils.parseJsonlFile(fname, function(o) return o end, rallyUtil)
notes: parseJsonlFile calls rallyUtil.trimString: the caller must pass the gameplay/rally/util module.
readJsonlLines skips neither empty lines nor `//` comments; jsonDecode will be called on each line as is.

startsWithDoubleSlash.desc: Tests whether the line starts with `//` (comment marker).

returns.desc: true if the line starts with //.

readFileToMemory.desc: Reads a whole file into memory with io.open.

returns.desc: Content, or nil if opening fails.

splitIntoLines.desc: Splits a text into lines on \r and \n; empty lines disappear.

parseJsonlFile.desc: Reads a JSONL file, decodes each non-empty, non-comment line, optionally applies processLine to the object and accumulates the non-nil results.

processLine.desc: Receives the decoded object, returns the object to keep or nil to ignore it.

returns.desc: List of objects, or nil on error.
Error message: "file not found" or "failed to read file".

readJsonlLines.desc: Simple reader based on io.lines (compatibility). Calls callback(obj) for each decoded line.

callback.desc: Called with the decoded object of each line.

returns.desc: false if the file does not exist, otherwise true.
